_: TRANSCRIPTION, NOT DESIGN. Every value here is read off the printed sheets in
./sheets/. Nothing is inferred, tidied or averaged. If a value here looks wrong,
the fix is to re-read the sheet, never to 'correct' the JSON.
This file is the DOMAIN contract, the way design/source/boa_design_v2.html is the
PIXEL contract (ADR-017) and design/source/boa_design_body.html is the frozen C8
lib/design.ts and the boa_acc_type / boa_acc_zone_access seed are both mirrors of
this file. tests/unit/accreditation-contract.test.ts proves all three agree.

rules.photo_id: + PHOTO ID - band alone is not entry; the matching ID and lanyard must be shown.
rules.void: Cut, taped or transferred bands are void: refuse entry and call the zone supervisor.
rules.turn_away: Anything outside a band's colours is a turn-away.
rules.absence: A (zone, tier) pair absent from `access` is a turn-away. There is no 'allowed' flag to get backwards.

_zone_order: ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING, as it was for the old boa_acc_zone enum. It is the
sheets' own 'ZONE n OF 6' numbering. Every zone strip renders in this order,
with zones a pass does NOT hold prefixed '-- '. The Postgres enum declares its
values in this same order. Do not reorder it.
Note the master map's legend prints the six in a different, two-column reading
order (Festival, Photo Pit, Main Stage / Backstage, Eddie's, Promoters). The
numbered sheets win: they are explicit and they are what a guard holds.

tiers.label: Stage
tiers.note: Festival - Photo pit - Backstage - Main stage

_tier_order: sort_order is the master sheet's own 'WHERE EACH BAND GOES' order, which runs
from most access to least. That is the order the desk and gate list tiers in.
artwork_no is the separate numbering on the wristband artwork sheet (01 GA ..
08 Photo), which is the printer's running order. It is recorded so a band in
hand can be tied back to its artwork row. It is NOT a display order.
print_qty for `photo` is null because the artwork sheet says QTY TBC. It is not
guessed, and a mirror that invents a number fails the contract test.
requestable=false means a vendor may not ask for it on the submission form:

discrepancies.what: Two sheets are headed 'ZONE n OF 5' - an older five-zone set with no Photo Pit.
discrepancies.resolution: The 'OF 6' sheets are current and win. The two 'OF 5' sheets are kept, prefixed 'superseded-', as the record of what was printed first.

discrepancies.what: The master sheet annotates ARTIST 'Every zone - +ID for lounges', implying photo ID only in the two lounges. The per-zone sheets mark ARTIST '+ PHOTO ID' in Photo Pit, Backstage and Main Stage as well.
discrepancies.resolution: The per-zone sheets win. They are the sheet a guard physically holds at that boundary, and the stricter reading fails safe. Transcribed as: artist requires photo ID everywhere EXCEPT Festival Area.

discrepancies.what: The wristband artwork sheet gives PHOTO as 'QTY TBC' while every other tier carries a number.
discrepancies.resolution: print_qty is null. Not zero, not guessed. Fill it in when the printer confirms.

discrepancies.what: The two BACKSTAGE sheets disagree on their own heading: the superseded one is 'ZONE 4 OF 5', the current one 'ZONE 5 OF 6'. Both carry the same allow list, including the 22:00 Promoters rule.
discrepancies.resolution: Numbering differs, content agrees. Recorded so nobody reads the pair as a rule change.
